interval_basis: election-specific rule observation (Electoral Code; rule text read: Dz.U. 2011 poz. 112), not legal enactment dates

label.en: List votes (one vote for a candidate on a list)
label.zh-CN: 名单票（投给名单上的一名候选人）

national_rules.nationalAllocation: Lists that pass the national threshold take part in the allocation; there is no national second tier.
national_rules.districtAllocation: In each of the 41 districts the votes of each qualifying list are divided by 1, 2, 3 and so on; the largest quotients up to the district seat number each win one seat (Art. 232).

thresholds.appliesTo: committee of a party or of voters

description.en: Lists below 5% of national valid votes take no part in the allocation (Art. 196 § 1).
description.zh-CN: 低于全国有效票 5% 的名单不参与席位分配（第 196 条第 1 款）。

description.en: Coalition committee lists need 8% of national valid votes (Art. 196 § 2).
description.zh-CN: 联盟委员会名单须获得全国有效票 8%（第 196 条第 2 款）。

minorityRepresentation.en: Committees formed by voters in registered national-minority organisations may be exempted from the 5% threshold on a declaration to PKW (Art. 197).
minorityRepresentation.zh-CN: 由已登记少数民族组织选民组成的委员会，可向国家选举委员会声明后免受 5% 门槛限制（第 197 条）。

notes.en: Open-list proportional representation in 41 districts, 460 seats. Electoral lists are presented by election committees, which are specific to one election. Published vote shares are rounded by PKW. A list’s number can repeat when committees stand in different districts, so list numbers are not unique.
notes.zh-CN: 41 个选区的开放名单比例代表制，共 460 席。名单由各届选举专设的选举委员会提出。公布的得票率由国家选举委员会四舍五入。不同选区的委员会可使用相同的名单编号，因此名单编号并不唯一。
